Version History

[edit]
Balance Patch History
VersionReleaseBalance Changes
2.0.42026-01-26
  • Wand of Negation charges from 4 to 3.
  • Wand of Negation now has a 5 second cooldown.
  • Wand of Negation cost from 150 to 120.
2.0.2.227962025-04-29
  • Ritual Dagger stock replenishment interval reduced from 90 to 75 seconds.
2.0.22025-04-16
  • Backpack shop requirement removed for all races.
  • Ritual Dagger gold cost reduced from 100 to 75; healing increased from 175 to 200.
  • Wand of Negation charges increased from 2 to 4; (undocumented) cooldown reduced from 5 to 0 seconds.
  • Ritual Dagger charges reduced from 2 to 1.
  • Wand of Negation is now a single target dispel that deals 200 damage to summoned units.
1.36.22024-06-04
  • Scroll of Healing removed from the Tomb of Relics
  • Wand of Negation added to the Tomb of Relics (2 charges, 150 gold, 5 second cooldown - available at tier 2)
1.32.102021-04-14
  • Ritual Dagger cost reduced from 125 to 100.
  • Rod of Necromancy cooldown reduced from 26 to 24.
  • Scroll of Town Portal cost reduced from 350 to 325.
1.32.92020-10-21
  • Rod of Necromancy cooldown increased from 22 to 26.
1.32.62020-06-02
  • Ritual Dagger total hit points regenerated per charge increased from 125 to 175.
  • Potion of Mana mana restored reduced from 150 to 125. Gold cost reduced from 200 to 150.
1.31.02019-05-28
  • New Item Ritual Dagger.
1.30.02018-08-08
  • Orb of Corruption armor reduction decreased from 5 to 4.
  • Sacrificial Skull no longer requires Graveyard to purchase.
  • Sacrificial Skull stock regeneration decreased from 60 to 45.
1.172004-09-20
  • Orb of Corruption debuff can no longer be dispelled.
  • All Orbs now affect magic-immune units.
  • Targeting an unwalkable location with a Scroll of Town Portal will now try to place units as close to that location as possible. If no valid location can be found, the units will be teleported to an area around the town hall.
1.122003-07-31
  • Within the Tomb of Relics maximum stock for the Rod of Necromancy has been reduced from 2 to 1.
1.102003-07-03
  • Added the ability to sell items back to shops.
  • The Tomb of Relics now sells Dust of Appearance, but no longer sells Lesser Clarity Potions.
  • Added the ability to see the inventory of the purchasing Hero when the shop is selected.
  • Shops have been given an improved interface which now allow players to select which Hero or unit is purchasing items, units, or services.
  • Orb of Corruption cost was reduced to 375 from 400, and its armor decrease has gone to 5 from 4.
  • Rod of Necromancy cooldown increased from 15 to 22.
